task.description:
WF-03 Step 1 (DIAGNOSE): Verify and refine the root cause analysis for ISS-0601. The diagnosis is mostly done by ORCH (in `docs/issues/ISS-0601.json`) but ISSUE-FIXER must independently verify by reading the source code AND running the failing tests in isolation. Failure category: 'test-vs-implementation-drift' — `src/engine/instance.zig InstanceStore.create()` (line ~860) takes a baseline snapshot at seq=1 via `self.snapshot_writer.takeSnapshot(allocator, uuid_bytes, &new_state, 1) catch {}` (non-fatal). The 4 failing tests (TC-ISS-601-01, -02, -05, -08 v2) were written before this baseline-snapshot feature was added and assert snapshot counts that are now off-by-one.

You MUST independently verify:
1. Read `src/engine/instance.zig` lines 800-870 and confirm the baseline snapshot at seq=1 is the implementation reality.
2. Read `src/engine/snapshot_writer.zig` `takeSnapshot()` and confirm it does INSERT INTO instance_state_snapshots on first call.
3. Read `tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig` and confirm the 4 failing tests assert snapshot counts that contradict the baseline snapshot behavior.
4. Run the failing test in isolation to confirm reproduction:
   ```bash
   BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss601
   ```
   Expected: 4 pass, 1 skip, 4 fail.
5. Optionally run a single test in isolation:
   ```bash
   BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss601 -- "TC-ISS-601-01"
   ```
6. Confirm the `audit_entries is immutable` red-herring by reading `tests/integration/helpers.zig` lines 344-395 (resetTestData) and lines 685-695 (deinit cleanup). The error is silently swallowed by deleteTableBestEffort (error.ServerError => {}). Optional secondary fix: move 'SET session_replication_role = replica' to the top of TestHarness.init() before resetTestData so audit_entries DELETE doesn't trigger the immutability guard.

FAILURE CATEGORY: test-vs-implementation-drift
AFFECTED CODE: tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig (4 test cases), tests/integration/helpers.zig (optional: resetTestData)
FIX SCOPE: small (1-2 test files, possibly helpers.zig)
BUSINESS LOGIC CHANGED: NO — only test expectations + (optional) test infrastructure cleanup
REGRESSION RISK: LOW — test code only

If diagnosis is verified, complete the handoff with PASS. If diagnosis is wrong, return FAIL with corrected root cause.

result.summary: ISS-0601 diagnosis independently verified by source-code reading. Confirmed: src/engine/instance.zig line 859-865 takes a baseline snapshot at snapshot_seq=1 after every successful InstanceStore.create() via self.snapshot_writer.takeSnapshot(allocator, uuid_bytes, &new_state, 1) catch {}. The four failing tests (TC-01 line 242 asserts snap_rows == 0; TC-02 line ~759 / TC-05 line ~957 / TC-08 v2 line 1124 all assert specific snapshot counts or seq values that are now off-by-one because the seq=1 baseline row pre-exists). The four passing tests (TC-03, TC-04, TC-07, TC-08 v1) all bypass inst_store.create() and call snapshot_writer.takeSnapshot() directly, so they are unaffected. The 'audit_entries is immutable' log noise observed during the 4 failing tests is INDEPENDENT of the root cause -- it comes from tests/integration/helpers.zig resetTestData() running DELETE FROM audit_entries (line ~365, silently caught by deleteTableBestEffort error.ServerError => {} at line ~390) BEFORE TestHarness.init() issues SET session_replication_role = 'replica'. Optional MINOR cleanup proposed (move SET session_replication_role to top of resetTestData's prologue, or exclude audit_entries from its DELETE list). Reproduction was attempted but the local environment has an unrelated Zig pg.Conn.connectUrl -> AuthenticationFailed failure that affects ALL zig build test-integration* targets in this workspace (pg_hba.conf ends with 'host all all all trust' and psql bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test works fine from the host, but the Zig startup handshake fails before any SQL is sent). Despite the env issue, the static diagnosis stands and CODE-DESIGNER can begin fix design.

issues.description: Unrelated infrastructure issue: Zig pg.zig connectUrl returns error.AuthenticationFailed against bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test despite pg_hba.conf's 'host all all all trust' rule and successful psql connection. Affects every zig build test-integration* target in this workspace (verified by running zig build test-integration-iss101 -- same failure). Code-level diagnosis of ISS-0601 is unaffected; separate ADHOC infra handoff needed before any test-binary can run. Filed separately so the env issue does not block the WF-03 fix path.

Cosmetic cleanup: tests/integration/helpers.zig resetTestData() DELETE of audit_entries fires immutability trigger because it runs before SET session_replication_role = 'replica'. Proposed fix: exclude audit_entries from resetTestData's DELETE list (it is wiped at TestHarness.deinit() anyway via ROLLBACK). Does not affect test correctness once the four assertion fixes in ISS-0601 land; only suppresses noisy 'audit_entries is immutable' log lines that obscure real failures.
